headlines.description: Víctor Muñoz marked his home debut with a late equaliser as Liverpool snatched a 2-2 draw for a second successive week in the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Muñoz rescues late draw for Liverpool vs. Forest

headlines.description: James Tarkowski struck with an added-time equaliser as Everton denied Bournemouth a first victory under head coach Marco Rose by snatching a 1-1 Premier League draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Tarkowski's late equaliser for Everton denies Bournemouth first win under Marco Rose

headlines.description: Hull continued their dream start to life in the Premier League as substitute Liam Millar snatched a 1-0 win away to Coventry.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull continue dream Premier League start at Coventry

headlines.description: Second-half goals by Anthony Elanga and Yoane Wissa helped Newcastle inflict a second consecutive defeat of the Premier League season on big-spending Tottenham.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Elanga and Yoane Wissa strike to leave Spurs pointless after two Premier League games

headlines.description: Chelsea's winning start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with a pulsating 4-3 win over Brighton at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea dazzle in attack again to beat Brighton 4-3, but defensive frailties remain

headlines.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin fired a late equaliser as Leeds fought back to salvage a 1-1 draw against Brentford in their opening home Premier League game of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Calvert-Lewin scores late equaliser to salvage a 1-1 draw with Brentford at Elland Road

headlines.description: Sunderland claimed their first win of the season as they edged out Fulham 1-0 thanks to Wilson Isidor's goal, just days after he signed a new contract with the Black Cats.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland get their first win of the season as Wilson Isidor strike seals 1-0 victory over Fulham

headlines.description: Bukayo Saka's second-half strike gave Arsenal an edgy 1-0 victory at Aston Villa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saka goal gives Arsenal 1-0 win over Villa

headlines.description: Norwich City finally got their Championship campaign up and running after a sluggish start as they recorded an emphatic 4-1 home win over struggling Burnley on Saturday.
